purpose: Install-useful silent embedded Doom image: the authorized display, immutable embedded WAD, and Doom baseline run while the complete native ESP32-P4 USB gamepad stack remains linked behind two independent zero authorization gates and makes no USB call.
runtime_blockers: The exact app-only one-shot was consumed and revoked after one verified install and launch; another write requires new authorization and a new durable ledger.
The app-local flash-resident volatile USB gate is zero and the reusable host component's independent flash-resident volatile authorization gate is also zero.
The zero-gate path initializes the proven display/WAD/video baseline, publishes neutral input, makes no platform USB call, and runs Doom with -nosound and -nomusic.
The compiled fallback fixture record is invalid by construction and no reviewed powered, current-limited, backfeed-isolated direct-data fixture is bound to this image.
Published CrowPanel V1.0-V1.2 schematics show that J16 reaches the P4 HS data pair but cannot source protected controller VBUS; USB runtime and fixture authorization remain false.
Native controller hotplug and gameplay acceptance have not run; this image must not be described as working controller support.
The WAD-bearing local firmware artifact is not authorized for redistribution.
